description: This Java class implements an SSL server socket factory for RMI, managing SSL configurations such as keystore, alias, and client authentication, and creating SSL server sockets with specified security settings.

classes.name: SSLServerSocketFactory
classes.description: Implements an RMI SSL server socket factory with configurable keystore, alias, and client authentication settings.

methods.name: setNeedClientAuth
methods.description: Configures whether the server socket requires client authentication.

methods.name: setKeyStore
methods.description: Sets the keystore location, type, and password for SSL configuration.

methods.name: setKeyStoreAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias for the SSL certificate in the keystore.

methods.name: createServerSocket
methods.description: Creates and returns an SSL server socket on the specified port with the configured security settings.
